result.reason: The operative language achieves Customer ownership and assignment of Deliverables, but it does not address Customer Data, expressly preserve Vendor pre-existing IP, grant the required perpetual licence to embedded Vendor IP, or exclude joint ownership. The margin comment’s references to other sections cannot cure those omissions without the referenced text. The blanket assignment may also sweep in embedded Vendor IP, while the new restriction on Vendor’s use of Deliverables goes beyond what is necessary and could impair permitted use of generic tools or know-how. The assignment and further-assurances language is otherwise professionally drafted.
